SESSION="Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED"

git add claude-plugins/autopilot/lib/github/prWatch.ts claude-plugins/autopilot/lib/github/prWatchLoop.ts claude-plugins/autopilot/lib/github/watch-pr.ts claude-plugins/autopilot/lib/github/prWatch.test.ts claude-plugins/autopilot/lib/github/prWatchLoop.test.ts claude-plugins/autopilot/lib/github/watchPr.test.ts claude-plugins/autopilot/lib/packContract.test.ts
git commit -q -F - <<EOF
feat(autopilot): add pr watcher that waits outside the model

- Add watch-pr.ts: a CLI that polls a pull request in its own process and
  prints one bounded JSON event, exiting 0 with telemetry on stderr
- Add prWatchLoop.ts: the fetch, head-verify, classify, decide and backoff
  loop behind injected gh reads, clock, sleep, state store and cancellation
- Add prWatch.ts: argument parsing, read-only gh api argv, check and
  feedback classification, event precedence and acknowledgement state
- Reconcile duplicate check runs to the newest per name and app, treat an
  empty check list as settled only with explicit check-free evidence
- Ship watch-pr.ts in the npm artifact via packContract requiredPaths

$SESSION
EOF

git add docs/20-pr-watcher.md README.md
git commit -q -F - <<EOF
docs(autopilot): add the pr watcher chapter

- Add docs/20-pr-watcher.md covering the CLI, the event table and its
  precedence, check and feedback classification, the state and
  acknowledgement contract, backoff budgets, and the three test layers
- Add the chapter 20 row to the README documentation table

Ordered before the pr-monitor change so the relative link chapter 5 adds
to this file resolves at every commit.

$SESSION
EOF

git add -A
git commit -q -F - <<EOF
feat(pr-monitor)!: wake only on actionable watcher events

- Replace the sleep-and-read polling loop in SKILL.md with a launch of
  lib/github/watch-pr.ts in the background, awaited by its completion
  notification, and drop Bash(sleep *) from allowed-tools
- Add an event contract section and a Phase 3 handler mapping each event
  to the Conflict Sweep, the CI fix workflow or pr-resolve, each followed
  by a relaunch carrying --ack
- Add a BLOCKED exit for auth loss, exhausted retries, an unreadable
  check policy, a head with no checks, a deadline or cancellation
- Key CI fix attempts to the event runId and drop the cooldown cycles
  from ci-remediation.md and conflict-sweep.md in favour of --ack
- Report the watcher event in background-mode.md without acknowledging it
- Retarget the pr-monitor sections asserted by prDeliveryContract and
  prConflictContract, and assert no sleep fence and four --ack relaunches

BREAKING CHANGE: pr-monitor requires a runtime that notifies the session
when a background process exits; without one it reports the missing
capability and stops instead of falling back to timed polling. It also
adds a BLOCKED outcome and writes watcher state under the git common dir.

$SESSION
EOF

echo "=== tree identical to pre-reset?"; [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = "7fe386f5fe820d3b48642eecd6f4cf9913ed3f18" ] && echo "yes" || echo "NO"
git log --oneline -3 | cat; git status --porcelain
